_comment: 月姫 -A piece of blue glass moon- (docs/games/tsukihime.md): sprites 6-48 are the shared menus (6-33) and the button bar (34-48), which auto-play must never press; the conv_ labels are the converter's screens (the picture-drawn pages conv_pg*, title, extras), reached from menus, not by auto-play
_engine_vars: engine_vars: script F words the exe reads that our conversion ignores (docs/games/tsukihime.md, research/typemoon/engine_vars.tsv); the numbers are 0.txt's: the converter numbers the F words in name order, so a new F word in a script shifts them (check: grep -c '%237\b' 0.txt gives 411, F1104's _WKST count)
